_about: Domino joints at the seat (tools/domino_ortho.py: orthophotos of each leg's outer face at 0.25 mm/px; read by eye on mm grids, figures/joinery/domino_measure.jpg). Chair frame mm; left given, right = mirror.

visible_end_mm.note: outline includes a dark glue/stain halo of about 0.5 mm per edge

design.provenance: fitted+assumed: visible ends 25-26 x 11-11.5 mm = Festool 10 mm Domino (24 x 10 section) plus halo; 8 mm (22 x 8) is too thin, 12+ mm too big

long_axis_tilt_deg.note: long axis tilted in the face, front end up (front leg ~15 deg, back leg ~5 deg): roughly along the seat edge

length_mm.provenance: assumed: not visible. Front: through the leg (33) + 25 into the seat edge. Back: 25 deep, see below

front_leg.centre_provenance: measured (hub, fix-list item 3, tools/front_domino/): on 19 photos of both legs the Domino centre sits 0.58 mm (sd 0.73) rearward of the middle between the leg face's two arrises (left 0.29, n 7; right 0.74, n 12); design = mean of the legs, 0.5 mm rearward of the flat outer face's middle. Was [-284.2, 466.7, 394.8], 2.0 mm rearward
front_leg.kind: leg lapped on the OUTSIDE of the seat's side edge; Domino runs across (x) through the leg into the seat edge; whole end inside the leg face

back_leg.kind: seat side edge BUTTS the leg's front edge with the outer faces flush (photo-consistent across 1504-1522: both halves sharp in the leg-face orthophoto); the Domino end straddles the joint line, ~15 mm in the leg and ~10 mm in the seat, driven in from outside (x)
back_leg.correction: PR #12 said all four legs are lapped; at the BACK legs the seat butts flush, only the front legs are lapped
